documentTitle: EASA Private Pilot Studies -- Chapter 12 Communications

sections.notes: EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications chapter-only extraction lines 1-183: pilot-training background on radio discipline, concise transmissions, listening watch, frequency expression, 8.33 kHz capability wording, and primary-reference pointers. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications chapter-only extraction lines 295-420: pilot-training background on message parts, numeric pronunciation, decimal usage, altitude/flight-level/QNH expression, and heading expression. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications chapter-only extraction lines 421-723: pilot-training background on CAP 413 number-expression notes, phonetic-letter pronunciation, transmission technique, initial contact, callsign use, and ATIS code mention on first call. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications chapter-only extraction lines 777-838: pilot-training background on Correction, Say Again, All Stations, multiple-station reply order, Confirm Squawk, and selected standard words from Break through Out.
